tests.test: PC-CF perimeter C-section versus X-braced subassembly process and stiffness comparison
tests.acceptance: No missing/detached braces or blocked test interfaces. Define laboratory load protocol, sample count, allowable dimensional error and correlation tolerance before qualification. Measure stiffness in the relevant print orientation and 23/50/70 C conditions; do not infer product capacity from these fixture coupons. Rerun the actual frame model with calibrated material/interface data.
